Let’s reason step by step.  

US/Eastern = UTC-5 (standard time, no DST mentioned).  
US/Mountain = UTC-7.  

Time difference = (target offset − source offset) = (−7) − (−5) = −2 hours.  

10 PM (22:00) July 7, 1249 − 2 hours = 20:00 (8 PM) July 7, 1249.  

No day change.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 20:00
